# Separate current documentation from historical records

## Status

`inactive`: Planned sixth child; blocked on computational filename normalization, separate explicit activation required, and no automatic successor activation.

## Objective

Move superseded plans and versioned harness narratives out of current guidance while preserving historically meaningful records with explicit status and replacements.

## Authorized scope

- Classify version-numbered harness pages, superseded plans, and chronological development narratives using the accepted inventory, then retain current guidance under descriptive paths and move historical records to a clearly indexed history section.
- Add status, represented period or revision, and current replacement information to retained historical pages where absent.
- Merge or delete only proven duplicate prose after preserving authoritative facts and repairing every maintained inbound reference.

## Completion criteria

- Readers can distinguish current guidance from history by navigation and page status rather than decoding version numbers.
- Every retained historical page identifies its status and current replacement when one exists, and no authoritative evidence or durable decision is lost.
- All maintained links resolve and Sphinx passes with warnings as errors.

## Exclusions

- Do not rewrite historical outcomes, acceptance, scientific evidence, or durable decisions; do not delete records solely because they are old.
- Do not change active Task selection, activate scientific work, or activate a successor automatically.
